productTitle: Unisex Wide Toe Box Lace Up Walking Shoes with Synthetic Leather Upper and Rubber Sole for Wholesale
textDesc:
Wide toe box design: A rounded forefoot and layered toe panels define this lace-up walking style.
Synthetic leather upper: Perforated panels and curved stitched overlays give the shoe its layered casual design.
Lace-up construction: Flat laces, a tongue lace keeper and a low-cut collar form the photographed opening.
Rubber sole: The photographed underside shows concentric grooves and small edge clusters.
Colour and EU assortment: Black, Light Gray, Beige, Yellow and Green in EU36-48; Red in EU36-42.
